newsitem.title: USA: Dominion dissidents set new consent date.
newsitem.headline: Dominion dissidents set new consent date.

text.p: The Committee to Revitalize Dominion Bridge Corp said Monday that it has obtained the affirmative endorsement of about 47 percent of Dominion Bridge Corp shareholders for its proposal to oust the company's management.

The Committee said that based on these results, it plans to continue its solicitation efforts. It said it will set August 20 as the new record date for written consents and will be asking shareholders to once again vote to oust the company's senior management.
